subject.title: Add session workspace file preview editing

question: Should OpenClaw accept an admin-only `sessions.files.set` Gateway method for editing session workspace text files once the branch is rebased onto current main?
rationale: The code path is an additive user-facing feature with proof, but it creates a new workspace write boundary and the current branch is conflicting against newer file-viewer/workspace-fs architecture.

options.title: Rebase and accept admin writer
options.body: Port the PR onto current workspace-fs and route-owned chat workspace code, then land it if the admin-only write boundary remains as tested.

options.title: Narrow the writer first
options.body: Require the set method to save only a maintainer-approved subset, such as files already previewed or touched by the session, before accepting the security boundary.

options.title: Do not ship core editing
options.body: Close or defer the PR if session workspace editing should live outside core Control UI or remain read-only for now.

recommendation.title: Rebase and accept admin writer
recommendation.body: Port the PR onto current workspace-fs and route-owned chat workspace code, then land it if the admin-only write boundary remains as tested.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the most recent current-main session file viewer/workspace-fs changes that this PR must rebase onto and is the clearest routing owner for the security-boundary choice.
